It remains to be seen if he'll have a minutes restriction, but having Maxey back in the mix is huge for the 76ers. He's averaging 26.5 points, 3.3 rebounds and 5.8 assists per game this season.

news.headline: Maxey (foot) will be a true game-time decision for Saturday's game against the Bucks, head coach Nick Nurse told Ky Carlin of USA Today.
news.story: According to Nurse, Maxey will go through his usual pregame warm-ups to see if he can play. If he suits up, he could have a minutes restriction, as Nurse also said Maxey "isn't there yet." If Maxey doesn't play, Anfernee Simons would remain in the backcourt alongside VJ Edgecombe.
